definitions.explanation: A type of vehicle transmission that requires manual gear shifting using a clutch pedal and gear stick.

examples.japanese: MT{車|しゃ}を{運転|うんてん}できる?
MTの{方|ほう}が{運転|うんてん}が{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: Driving a manual is more fun.

examples.japanese: MT{免許|めんきょ}を{持|も}っていれば、AT{車|しゃ}も{運転|うんてん}できる。
examples.english: If you have an MT license, you can also drive automatic cars.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of 'Manual Transmission'.

USAGE:
MT cars are becoming increasingly rare in Japan, but some driving enthusiasts prefer them. An MT license allows driving both MT and AT vehicles.

COLLOCATIONS:
・MT{車|しゃ} - manual car
・MT{免許|めんきょ} - MT license (allows driving both MT and AT)
